checkpoint.title: The code run by the double swap: the item x999 in the PC, the asked count in the bag, saved

events.why: The code writes the item storage's slot 30: fewer than 30 stacks stored; and the bag's count of the item plus withdraw at most 999.

The Pokémon in Box 1 slot 1 moved to Box 3 slot 2 (skipped when it is there), 0x0351 shifted with it twice: the second shift runs the box names. Box 3 is told by its code name, the same for every item. Then the box screen must still answer.
The code's item: a stack of it reads x999 in ITEM STORAGE.
The run's withdraw count taken to the bag, the bag's count read before and after; the rest stays in the PC.
Keeps the items, only once every check passed.

metadata.notes: Run with --options item=<slug> withdraw=<n>. Starts at 01-enter-code's code save, below the Route 4 Pokémon Center's PC, and ends there saved. Any failure goes back to the code save, unsaved (a save state on mGBA, a soft reset on the Switch), and stops: no retry runs the code again on its own.
